outgoing.name: Isambard Kingdom Brunel
outgoing.excerpt: The Chepstow railway bridge was built by Isambard Kingdom Brunel in 1852.

outgoing.name: Newcastle upon Tyne
outgoing.excerpt: This was the same year as Stephenson's tied-arch high level bridge at Newcastle upon Tyne, which was supposed to have influenced Brunel at Chepstow.
